Bear was an Australian koolie nobody wanted. His family gave him up - he ate through the walls of their apartment. Researchers saw his obsession as a skill. They trained him to sniff out koalas in burned forests, up to 20 times faster than any human search team. During Australia's 2019-20 fires, he found over 100 koalas. He retired in 2026 after ten years of service. The drive that no family could live with saved hundreds of koalas. - Fun Facts

Nek Chand was an Indian roads inspector who began secretly building a garden in a forbidden forest gorge around 1965. He hid thousands of sculptures there for about a decade, made from broken bangles, tiles and factory waste. Officials discovered it in 1975 and could have torn it down. Instead they gave him a salary and 50 workers. The Rock Garden now covers 40 acres with over 5,000 statues. - Fun Facts

Amelia Earhart's plane may have been hiding in plain sight for 89 years. A researcher spotted a strange shape in a Pacific lagoon in 2020. The same shape turns up in aerial photos from 1938, just months after Earhart disappeared. Researchers say its size and outline match the tail and wing of her plane. A Purdue-backed team sets sail July 28 to investigate. - Fun Facts

The White House interior is a 1950s building. Engineers found it near collapse in 1948. Margaret Truman's piano leg had just crashed through the floor. Workers gutted every floor down to the bare exterior walls. A new steel frame went up inside the hollow shell, foundations dug 20 feet deep. To protect the 1817 walls, they disassembled a bulldozer and rebuilt it inside. - Fun Facts

Eeyore the family dog ran straight to a deputy's patrol car in Destin, Florida when his owner's 86-year-old mom fell on a night walk and couldn't get up - then led Deputy Devon Miller right to where she lay on the sidewalk. She got it on bodycam: "You're such a good boy. Grandma loves you." - Fun Facts

Winnie-the-Pooh was a real bear. Harry Colebourn, a Canadian soldier headed to WWI, bought an orphaned cub for $20 at a train stop in 1914 and named her Winnipeg. When he shipped out to France, he left her at London Zoo, so gentle that keepers let a boy named Christopher Robin climb into her enclosure and feed her condensed milk. He renamed his teddy bear after her. - Fun Facts

Marcel Ravidat was 18 when his dog went down a hole near Montignac, France. He climbed in after it, then returned days later with three friends. They found cave walls covered in painted animals: over 600 images made some 17,000 years ago. One black bull stretches over 17 feet across the rock. Visitors' breath damaged the paintings so badly the cave closed in 1963. A replica nearby lets people see it today. - Fun Facts

Hannah Waddingham spent 10 hours actually being waterboarded on the set of Game of Thrones, strapped to a table while liquid was poured over her face for Septa Unella's torture scene. She developed chronic claustrophobia as a result - and called it second only to childbirth as the worst day of her life. - Fun Facts

Archie Williams spent 36 years in Angola for a crime he didn't commit - wrongfully convicted in 1983 after a witness misidentified him. A fingerprint database cleared him in 2019, identifying another man who had already died behind bars. A year later, he sang 'Don't Let the Sun Go Down on Me' on America's Got Talent. Every judge stood up. - Fun Facts

On April 18, 2024, a 71-year-old man's SUV slammed into a guardrail on Interstate 94 in St. Paul and burst into flames - he was unconscious and trapped inside. Seven strangers stopped, ran into the smoke, and pulled him out seconds before the car was fully engulfed. One of them, a UPS driver named Michael Coy, climbed inside the burning vehicle to unbuckle him. - Fun Facts

Göbekli Tepe in Turkey is the oldest known temple on Earth. Its massive stone pillars date back roughly 11,600 years, about 6,000 years before Stonehenge was built. Hunter-gatherers built it before writing, metal tools, or farming even existed. Then they deliberately buried the enclosures, and nobody knows exactly why. - Fun Facts
